island.label: An island of the places this story happens in — pick one to look closer

bahay-kubo.title: the bahay kubo
bahay-kubo.body: Where it starts. Stilts, bamboo and a nipa roof — the house that taught me a good structure is mostly what you leave out.

shore.title: the shore
shore.body: A banca pulled up on the sand, a palm leaning over it. Home, and the habit of making do with whatever floats.

sari-sari.title: the sari-sari store
sari-sari.body: A counter, a striped awning, a strip of sachets. The first lesson in shipping small and shipping often.

duomo.title: Milan
duomo.body: Marble spires on the other side of the island. The city I work from now, a long way from the first one.

tram.title: the tram
tram.body: Orange, unhurried, older than anyone riding it, and still on time. An argument for maintaining good things rather than replacing them.

studio.title: the studio
studio.body: A desk, a CRT still glowing, a scaffold tower beside it. Where the architecture gets drawn — and redrawn.

easel.title: the easel
easel.body: Canvas, brushes, a sketchbook open on the ground. The other half of the work, and the half that keeps the first one honest.

graves.title: the graves
graves.body: Two crosses on the quiet side of the island, each hung with the hat its owner wore. Proof a story can end and still keep teaching you something, years later.

inspiration.verse: God said, "Let there be light", and there was light
